newsitem.title: USA: Packard Bell NEC cuts prices on notebook computers.
newsitem.headline: Packard Bell NEC cuts prices on notebook computers.

text.p: The NEC Computer Systems Division of Packard Bell NEC Inc. Friday cut prices on its Versa notebook computers by up to 20 percent.
NEC has three lines of Versa notebook computers, which provide a variety of configurations and technology to cater to different users.
Under the new price structure, the NEC Versa 2405 notebook computer will cost $1,499 at stores, down from $1,699 previously.

NEC Computer Systems is a division of Packard Bell NEC Inc., one of the largest computer companies in the world. Packard Bell NEC is based in Sacramento, Calif. The parent company is NEC Corp. of Japan.
